name: Yoshino (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yoshino town emblem in maroon: a ring open at the bottom above a stylised loop, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Yoshino, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in September 1968.

features.role: Yoshino town emblem — a ring open at the bottom above a stylised loop, like a stylised character
